exact_tokens: UI_Wiring_Rules.md already treats correlation_id as part of the command envelope, but the matrix/schema pair has no way to declare or verify passthrough obligations for route payloads, subject IDs, or correlation continuity into downstream events
Tighten UI_Wiring_Rules.md so reusable navigation commands and subject-open commands are treated as first-class wiring shapes rather than smuggled through generic args
There is still no schema-level place to express argument-contract requirements for subject-open or route-payload commands
notes: Wiring schema needs extension with route-aware fields: command_arg_contract_ref?, route_target_kind?, subject_kind?, deprecated_alias_for?, preconditions?, arg_passthrough_requirements?, correlation_passthrough?
